With the official slogan being Serious Fun, it is no wonder people come from over 25 countries to attend this one of a kind regatta. Given this year's lineup, we are expecting some of the best sailing in St. Maarten. Watch the highlights of the 2015 edition!

programme.title: Tidal
programme.desc: Tidal follows the journey of Lisa Beasley. After she suffered a horrible BASE jumping accident, she struggles to return to the ocean, but ends convincing herself to venture back into the water. Lisa’s journey begins with a childhood love of water and sea life. Lucky of surviving the accident, she must now face an immense recovery period that brings her closer to her mother as well as her first love: the sea.As Lisa struggles to find an exercise she can handle, she starts discovering the beauty surrounding Cape Town’s ocean. The tidal pools in particular became very meaningful to Lisa’s recovery, and she must now work to protect them from the harmful historical cleaning protocols that kill the marine life she has come to love.Watch Lisa’s inspirational transformation and realisation of the beauty of the ocean in this impactful documentary that reminds us of the importance of self-recovery and reconnection with the ocean. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus on the French team. They dominated the KiteFoil World Series scene, with many great performances. We’ll zoom in on Axel Mazella who clinched the Kitefoil European title and his second Kitefoil World title last season. Finally, we meet four-time World Champion, Daniela Moroz, who’ll share some tips for how to gybe in the best possible way.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 4
programme.desc: We are finally back to action! After months of waiting due to the Covid-19 pandemic, athletes and sports enthusiasts had the chance to return to some high-end performances and demanding racing; for the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Team Relay European Championships that took place in Ebensee - Lake Traunsee, Austria. Relieve the best moments on Kite Masters.

programme.title: PRADA 36th America's Cup - Highlight
programme.desc: The moment everyone was waiting for has arrived: the 36th America’s Cup has started. Postponed a couple of days due to restrictions, it has finally started with a big start. Watch the highlights of the competition.

programme.title: Tiree Wave Classic - 2016
programme.desc: For 30 years, a small sleepy island found off the North West Coast of Scotland has played host to one of the most prestigious events known amongst the windsurfing community. 61 competitors have arrived on the island for the Tiree Wave Classic. This is about to become the stage for top level windsurfing techniques in one of the most challenging conditions the UK has to offer.

programme.title: Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

The defender team started the day with an aggressive start and taking the lead, but Luna Rossa Prada Pirelli came to win this competition. What will happen at the end of this day? Watch the highlights of the competition.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9
programme.desc: Welcome back sailors! Today we are indulging in the most fragrant gardens of the islands of Cres and Losinj where the beauty of nature is next level. These islands are also known as the favourite place for many boaters who like to enjoy beautiful beaches and top restaurants. Let's dive in!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10
programme.desc: In this episode we are in the Opatija Riviera - the jewel box of the Northern Adriatic. With its enchanting architecture and romantic seaside promenades, it instantly takes us back to glorious summer days of the historical elite and royals. Now, let us take you here in Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 8 - Mali & Losinj
Inside Superyachts - Episode 6
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world’s most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 6
programme.desc: When the out-spending was impossible, out-thinking did the job. Emirates Team New Zealand has dominated the 35th America's Cup Match seven to one to become the new Defender. After nearly two decades, the end of both the Alinghi and Oracle Eras is here and the kiwis are back on the top of the world. We will watch the battles, highlights and comments of this historic victory.

programme.title: Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Simpson Bay where the St. Maarten Heineken Regatta will celebrate its 35th anniversary edition! With the official slogan being Serious Fun, it is no wonder people come from over 25 countries to attend this one of a kind regatta. Given this year's lineup, we are expecting some of the best sailing in St. Maarten. Watch the highlights of the 2015 edition!

programme.title: Tiree Wave Classic - 2016
programme.desc: For 30 years, a small sleepy island found off the North West Coast of Scotland has played host to one of the most prestigious events known amongst the windsurfing community. 61 competitors have arrived on the island for the Tiree Wave Classic. This is about to become the stage for top level windsurfing techniques in one of the most challenging conditions the UK has to offer.

programme.title: Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus on the French team. They dominated the KiteFoil World Series scene, with many great performances. We’ll zoom in on Axel Mazella who clinched the Kitefoil European title and his second Kitefoil World title last season. Finally, we meet four-time World Champion, Daniela Moroz, who’ll share some tips for how to gybe in the best possible way.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 4
programme.desc: We are finally back to action! After months of waiting due to the Covid-19 pandemic, athletes and sports enthusiasts had the chance to return to some high-end performances and demanding racing; for the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Team Relay European Championships that took place in Ebensee - Lake Traunsee, Austria. Relieve the best moments on Kite Masters.

programme.title: Tidal
programme.desc: Tidal follows the journey of Lisa Beasley. After she suffered a horrible BASE jumping accident, she struggles to return to the ocean, but ends convincing herself to venture back into the water. Lisa’s journey begins with a childhood love of water and sea life. Lucky of surviving the accident, she must now face an immense recovery period that brings her closer to her mother as well as her first love: the sea.As Lisa struggles to find an exercise she can handle, she starts discovering the beauty surrounding Cape Town’s ocean. The tidal pools in particular became very meaningful to Lisa’s recovery, and she must now work to protect them from the harmful historical cleaning protocols that kill the marine life she has come to love.Watch Lisa’s inspirational transformation and realisation of the beauty of the ocean in this impactful documentary that reminds us of the importance of self-recovery and reconnection with the ocean. Available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 7 - GP of China - Zhengzhou
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Episode 1 Season Preview
programme.desc: Welcome to the 25th season of the UIM ABP Aquabike World Championship. The world's best jetski racers are once again looking for the UIM ABP World title in six categories: the Ski Division GP1, the Ski Ladies GP1, the Freestyle, the Runabout GP1 as well as the Ski GP Junior 3.3 and 3.2.They will prove their skills across different Grand Prixes around the world. The rider who gets the most points throughout the season will be crowned world champion.Get to know what to expect from this year's edition in this season preview.

programme.title: PRADA America's Cup World Series and Christmas Regatta
programme.desc: The America’s Cup is the oldest trophy in international sport. A competition that remounts to 1851 when an American schooner won a race around the Isle of Wight. Now, it is the pinnacle of yachting: top performance boats and a crew that has to be part machine and part scientist if they want to stand a chance at one of the toughest competitions.To determine who will face the defender of the America’s Cup the other teams that seek victory fight the Prada Cup. They have made the latest version of the trophy, special for this occasion. Created by the renowned designer Marc Newson and handcrafted by Florentine silversmiths, only one team will take back home this trophy.Become part of the crew formed by superheroes as they fight to get the advantage and be the fastest in the water. In this race split seconds determine victory, and a single mistake could mean going back home empty-handed. Watch the highlights and best moments of the PRADA America’s Cup World Series and the Christmas Regatta, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: “We’re just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans.” –Luise Grossmann.Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. The founders of FiveOceans give ocean rubbish a new life, using plastic collected from the Indian Ocean, proving it is possible to close the cycle with ocean waste and high quality surf gear.In this stunning documentary, they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. With their background in engineering, the unrivalled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities as the two friends battle their way to achieve a much higher goal: reducing the plastic that ends up in the oceans they surf.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2017
programme.desc: The Paris Boat Show is considered by the nautical industry one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public, this event is an absolute must, and we agree there is no other place like the Paris Nautic as France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the world. Thousands are expected to arrive on the 3rd of December until the following weekend, and fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles for the latest innovation and best deals. Are you going to miss it? Come join us, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 9 - Cres & KRK
What the Sea Gives me
programme.desc: What The Sea Gives Me is a feature length documentary comprised of intimate & candid interviews with some of the ocean’s most extraordinary ambassadors including Great White shark researcher Brett McBride, artist Matt Beard, photographer Chris Burkard, bodysurfer Angie Oschmann, conservationist Jean-Michelle Cousteau, free-diver Herbert Nitsch. We give you an honest and personal look through the eyes of those who thrive under the most extreme water conditions, those ensuring the proper care of the oceans for future generations and those who simply derive a sense of pure joy from the sea.

programme.title: Nautical Adventure In A Landlocked Country
programme.desc: Switzerland: home to the Alps and important water competitions like the Bol d’Or Mirabaud, the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Today it becomes the chosen scenario for this Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country. From extreme wakeboarding to canoe polo, we will discover that, despite being located far from the sea, Switzerland has a vibrant nautical scene.Get ready to accompany Nautical Channel’s host, Lucia Metzbauer, as she goes wakeboarding with local Swiss pros, learns about the annual Match Race regatta, tries her hand at Stand-Up-Paddle, and discovers the little known sport of Canoe Polo! This country has much to offer, so don’t miss out on its beautiful scenery that will have you pack your bags to come visit on the first occasion.Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country reminds us that water sports can be practiced even in countries that do not border the ocean. An inland fanta-sea for those nautical intrepids that are looking for ways of widening their horizons. Welcome to the Alps.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi arrives to the ancient Arabic town of Lamu. She is about to discover what dhow culture means to the people of Kenya. She spends three days with the incredible Ali Lamu, dhow builder and carpenter who is trying to save the lost art of dhow building. A unique experience will reveal many secrets of the location and this traditional work that is getting lost amongst younger people.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 11
programme.desc: In this last episode of the season, we visit Zagreb, the capital of the country and one of the most popular destinations in Croatia. As a city with a rich history and an abundance of cultural events, it is the perfect place to include at the end of our Croatian adventure. Let's check it out!

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 4
programme.desc: The February episode is Valentine’s Day themed! We meet the new members of SoftBank Team Japan and find out what it takes to make it onto the team, as well as their thoughts on love. Then, we get an exclusive look at the site of the AC35 Event Village, and take the ultimate challenge – trying out for Bermuda’s Red Bull Youth America’s Cup team.

programme.title: The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl - Naxos Part 1
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl has just arrived to the island of Naxos for the start of summer and the windy season. Naxos is a gem in the Aegean sea, where laughter, activity , sprwaling nature and beautiful beaches await. She is determined to explore the diversity of the island, from ancient greek ruins to modern watersports. Will she be able to handle the strong winds or will rough seas get the better of her?

programme.title: Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: IWWF World Waterski Championships - Ep1 - Highlight
Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: There are two elements that grabbed our attention during the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Relay European Championships: the UK’s Connor Bainbridge and the Polish team.Along with his teammate Elli Aldridge, Connor managed to defend his European title. Meanwhile, the Polish team was the great surprise of the championship, having two out of their six teams qualifying to the gold fleet. After that, we will focus on the Kite venues hosting the hottest action from the kite events.We will discover why riders love these locations and what makes the International Kiteboarding Association so confident in the venues. Finally, we reencounter four-time world champion, Daniela Moroz, who shared some more golden Kiteboarding tips.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As we come to the end of the 2020 series, we'll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding as well as the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Later on, we are set to find out what happened during the last event of the season, the 2020 KiteFoil European Championships taking place in Playa de las Burras, Gran Canaria, Spain. We end our journey travelling to the USA to meet one of the most popular riders in the world: Daniela Moroz.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 19
programme.desc: LG Yachts is a shipyard founded by three good friends whom are used to working together and racing boats together; and the Anvera brand brings to the market super tenders of 48 and 55 feet. We dive into Anvera before moving into the Bluegame BGX 70, an innovative yacht for its style and layout.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 20
programme.desc: Our journey this season on The Boat Show is approaching its end. To end it, we try out the Dominator 28M Ilumen, but we prefer to call it by its name Cadet V as every Dominator yacht is custom built for its owner. Then, in the immense range of Beneteau motorboats, the Flyer line includes entry models, and we try out the Flyer 8 Sundeck from this shipyard.

programme.title: PRADA America's Cup World Series and Christmas Regatta
programme.desc: The America’s Cup is the oldest trophy in international sport. A competition that remounts to 1851 when an American schooner won a race around the Isle of Wight. Now, it is the pinnacle of yachting: top performance boats and a crew that has to be part machine and part scientist if they want to stand a chance at one of the toughest competitions.To determine who will face the defender of the America’s Cup the other teams that seek victory fight the Prada Cup. They have made the latest version of the trophy, special for this occasion. Created by the renowned designer Marc Newson and handcrafted by Florentine silversmiths, only one team will take back home this trophy.Become part of the crew formed by superheroes as they fight to get the advantage and be the fastest in the water. In this race split seconds determine victory, and a single mistake could mean going back home empty-handed. Watch the highlights and best moments of the PRADA America’s Cup World Series and the Christmas Regatta, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Tiree Wave Classic - 2016
programme.desc: For 30 years, a small sleepy island found off the North West Coast of Scotland has played host to one of the most prestigious events known amongst the windsurfing community. 61 competitors have arrived on the island for the Tiree Wave Classic. This is about to become the stage for top level windsurfing techniques in one of the most challenging conditions the UK has to offer.

programme.title: Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 9 - Cres & KRK
Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: There are two elements that grabbed our attention during the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Relay European Championships: the UK’s Connor Bainbridge and the Polish team.Along with his teammate Elli Aldridge, Connor managed to defend his European title. Meanwhile, the Polish team was the great surprise of the championship, having two out of their six teams qualifying to the gold fleet. After that, we will focus on the Kite venues hosting the hottest action from the kite events.We will discover why riders love these locations and what makes the International Kiteboarding Association so confident in the venues. Finally, we reencounter four-time world champion, Daniela Moroz, who shared some more golden Kiteboarding tips.

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: “We’re just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans.” –Luise Grossmann.Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. The founders of FiveOceans give ocean rubbish a new life, using plastic collected from the Indian Ocean, proving it is possible to close the cycle with ocean waste and high quality surf gear.In this stunning documentary, they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. With their background in engineering, the unrivalled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities as the two friends battle their way to achieve a much higher goal: reducing the plastic that ends up in the oceans they surf.

programme.title: Tiree Wave Classic - 2017
programme.desc: Thanks to the famed Atlantic swells that roll along its coastline and despite being home to just 650 people, this watersports mecca attracts surfers and windsurfers from across the world. Tiree's wild coastline is battered by some of the UK's highest wind ratings, creating the perfect meteorological conditions to host the longest running windsurfing event in the world - the Tiree Wave Classic. It is time for the 2017 edition. Come join us!

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Surfer's Blood
programme.desc: Renowned surf photographer and filmmaker Patrick Trefz explores the essence of the sport he loves by profiling those who inspire him. Surfers' Blood tells the universal story of true individuals that share deep bloodlines connected to the sea.From wooden fishing boats in the Basque Country coast with oar and surfboard shaper Patxi Oliden to the metropolis of San Francisco and the eccentric computer shapes of Apple fame designer Thomas Meyerhoffer, unique people unite by a deep connection to the sea.Watch it on Nautical Channel.

programme.desc: Thanks to the famed Atlantic swells that roll along its coastline and despite being home to just 650 people, this watersports mecca attracts surfers and windsurfers from across the world. Tiree's wild coastline is battered by some of the UK's highest wind ratings, creating the perfect meteorological conditions to host the longest running windsurfing event in the world - the Tiree Wave Classic. It is time for the 2017 edition. Come join us!

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: There are two elements that grabbed our attention during the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Relay European Championships: the UK’s Connor Bainbridge and the Polish team.Along with his teammate Elli Aldridge, Connor managed to defend his European title. Meanwhile, the Polish team was the great surprise of the championship, having two out of their six teams qualifying to the gold fleet. After that, we will focus on the Kite venues hosting the hottest action from the kite events.We will discover why riders love these locations and what makes the International Kiteboarding Association so confident in the venues. Finally, we reencounter four-time world champion, Daniela Moroz, who shared some more golden Kiteboarding tips.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: As we come to the end of the 2020 series, we'll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding as well as the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Later on, we are set to find out what happened during the last event of the season, the 2020 KiteFoil European Championships taking place in Playa de las Burras, Gran Canaria, Spain. We end our journey travelling to the USA to meet one of the most popular riders in the world: Daniela Moroz.

programme.title: EcoFin Documentary
programme.desc: “We’re just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans.” –Luise Grossmann.Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. The founders of FiveOceans give ocean rubbish a new life, using plastic collected from the Indian Ocean, proving it is possible to close the cycle with ocean waste and high quality surf gear.In this stunning documentary, they prove their mission and reveal a transparent value chain of the waste material to design a performance product for surfers. With their background in engineering, the unrivalled story is underlined by surfing, adventure and great personalities as the two friends battle their way to achieve a much higher goal: reducing the plastic that ends up in the oceans they surf.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 8 - GP of United Arab Emirates - Sharjah
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Episode 2 Portimao, Portugal
programme.desc: The UIM-ABP Aquabike World Championship Oﬀshore has started its new season in the European City of Sport for 2019, Portimao, Portugal. It attracts the world’s top male and female riders from around the globe who compete on cutting edge equipment, delivering a mix of fast paced racing, nail biting action and non-stop excitement. More than 70 riders from 26 countries will battle in six categories: the Ski Division GP1, the Ski Ladies GP1, the Freestyle, the Runabout GP1 as well as the Ski GP Junior 3.3 and 3.2.In this episode, we will focus on all the ski action from the Grand Prix of Portugal.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 11
programme.desc: In this last episode of the season, we visit Zagreb, the capital of the country and one of the most popular destinations in Croatia. As a city with a rich history and an abundance of cultural events, it is the perfect place to include at the end of our Croatian adventure. Let's check it out!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1
programme.desc: Hello Sailors! It’s such a great pleasure to welcome you to the new season of Sail-ho Croatia. We’re setting off on yet another incredible journey sailing the Adriatic starting from the lush and picturesque Neretva valley and the town of Ploče. Stay tuned and enjoy the ride!

programme.title: Nice Ultimed
programme.desc: From April 24th to May 6th, four elite skippers will respectively compete on the biggest racing boats in the world. Nice UltiMed is a clash of titans right in the heart of the Mediterranean, and it is worthy of the attention of spectators worldwide.The crews of 3-6 will participate in an offshore sprint, starting and ending in Nice, France. They will be sailing on maxi trimarans measuring more than 30 meters and will pass by Corsica, Sardinia, the Balearic Islands, and the coastline of the Région Provence-Alpes-Côte d´Azur.The skippers will be sailing assisted by their crews on their maxi trimarans, exploiting the full power and speed of these machines.Have you ever seen anything like it? Join us as we follow along on what promises to be an unprecedented race where outstanding sailors are capable of taming the oceans single-handedly on the Ultimed.

programme.title: 52 Super Series - Ep. 3 - Marina Rubicon Lanzarote 52 Super Series Sailing Week
Heineken Regatta - Episode 1
programme.desc: The St. Maarten Heineken Regatta is about to celebrate its 36th edition. This world renowned sailing event offers four days of World Class Racing, with trade winds coming from the North East, an average temperature of 25°C and crystal clear waters. Courses will take participants along coastal races, as well as around the island, presenting the beautiful beaches, rock formations and other scenery. On shore, participants and visitors will be able to enjoy the culture, cuisine and music from both the Dutch and French side. Are you going to miss out? Come dive in at the 2016 Heineken Regatta!

programme.title: Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 4
programme.desc: Today the Clipper Race crews are going to face up their biggest challenge in this epic circumnavigation of the planet: the Mighty Pacific Ocean. Its fearsome reputation is well deserved and it is not clear how everyone will cope. We meet two novice Mexican sailors who join for the ride of their lives; and a sailor testing her nerve, as the teams are pushed to their limits, facing hurricane force winds, monstruous waves and relentless freezing temperatures.

programme.title: Sailing Documentary Show
programme.desc: Sailing boats have always come in different shapes and size. Whether if they are used for competition, fishing or recreational use, competition has always been at the heart of sport, pushing boundaries in technological advancements.The Extreme Sailing Series combines the top class sailing teams and the advanced innovations in technology, and watching the races becomes a thrill to spectators. With circuits that range through eight global events, the Extreme Sailing Series is breaking boundaries. Follow the journey of boats that are some of the fastest in production and that can reach speeds of just under 40 knots or almost 75 kilometres per hour.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: Since 1977, the Cannes Yachting Festival takes place every September in elegant, luxurious surroundings in the sparkling bay of Cannes. We are ready for the 2018 edition that promises the latest trends in the nautical industry. Jump on board the 2018 Cannes Yachting Festival to discover superyachts, equipment, regattas, competitions and more.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2018
programme.desc: The Nautic Paris International Boat Show returns in 2018 to welcome hundreds of nautical enthusiasts inside its doors. We will be able to find out the latest trends in nautical equipment, sailing vessels, superyachts or rental services. Are you ready to discover the latest in the nautical industry? Come dive with us in the 2018 Salon Nautique Paris.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Episode 10 - Brijuni & Istria
The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: While filming South To Sian, a pair of adventurers dived into what began as a three-month trip and turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration.On boards, bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, Harrison Roach and Zye Norris discovered if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.South to Sian Journals is a collection of stories documenting the people, places & adventures that occurred during the 2 years making “South To Sian” - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers.Extremely entertaining and insightful, “Journals” documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.desc: The UIM-ABP Aquabike World Championship Oﬀshore has started its new season in the European City of Sport for 2019, Portimao, Portugal. programme.title: How to Become a Rich Yogi - The importance of a quiet mind
programme.desc: In this episode, Rob talks a little about how to find more happiness in life. After dedicating his life to understanding what leads to true happiness, he’s come to learn that the root of unhappiness seems to come from an overactive mind. Tune in to the full video to learn more.

programme.title: Kino in Seattle
programme.desc: I don’t think we’re in Florida anymore! Follow along with Kino during her trip to Seattle, Washington as she adjusts to the colder weather, sets off in search of a hot cup of chai, tours historic areas like the Gas Works Park, supports local businesses, and shares the Ashtanga Yoga method with a group of excited yogis at the Yoga Lab Northwest.

programme.title: How to Become a Rich Yogi - How to quiet our mind

programme.title: Kino in San Francisco

After all those handstands and asanas in front of scenic views, we stop for some of local food and to enjoy the local color. Kino's signature sense of humor and storytelling take center stage in this episode, as she delights in sharing San Francisco with you!

In this episode, you’ll get an inside look at Kino’s morning ritual, which she insists is part of what keeps her grounded amidst all the traveling. Follow Kino around the beautiful city as she teaches to a group of dedicated yogis and gives you an inside look at the city’s tourist sights through the eyes of yoga. In this class we’ll build up to a steady, well constructed Down Dog by focusing on the shoulders in a series of preparatory postures. Flow through child's pose, table top, puppy pose and sun salutations as you create healthy patterns of movement and breath control. programme.desc: Learn the fundamentals of yoga in this short, meditative practice that builds up to the twisting pose, Marichasana C.

programme.title: Halasana
programme.desc: This class establishes a connection to breath, body and mind before flowing into the poses. Use props to support your practice, which builds up to the shoulderstand, Halasana.

programme.title: Personal Relationships
programme.desc: Join Kino for a 20 minute meditation on love and tuning into the flow of love in personal relationships. Begin your practice of mindful awareness by feeling the breath. Allow the breath to become an anchor that redirects the mind to the inner experience. Check in with the physical body and the sensations arising there and filtering into awareness. Tap into the energy of the heart and the love that flows there, allow this feeling to spread to all beings and yourself.

programme.title: Healing and Happiness
programme.desc: Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, feeling the breath and sensation in the body as a way of cultivating inward focus. Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Yoga Is Unity
programme.desc: The traditional definition of yoga is unity. We will explore this concept through the restorative Pigeon Pose. Begin practice with a reflection on the connection between breath, body and mind. Next, move through a series of long holds in child’s pose, puppy poses and forward folding. Take a supported hip opener using props if you have them handy and then move into another long hold, this time in Pigeon Pose. Take note of any sensations and feelings that arise, offering yourself true care and opening up to a sense of wholeness.

programme.title: Breathe - Freedom
programme.desc: In the 40-minute practice, Kino leads you through a journey with the breath. Move into the inner space of the body by reconnecting with the power and the vehicle of the breath. Discover the child-like innocence of your body as you engage in this breath focused practice with awareness and intention.

programme.title: Yoga Is Joy
programme.desc: Open your heart to an experience of pure joy. We’ll use Happy Baby pose to explore what yoga truly is. Flow through child’s pose, puppy pose, squats and hip openers before making your way into the sweet release of Happy Baby. No judgement, no fight, no force… use this practice to touch the unscathed, joyful innocence within you.

programme.title: Yoga Is Sanctuary
programme.desc: Today’s lesson is about sanctuary and how to find a place of calm and peace deep within yourself. We’ll use the backbend Ustrasana, or Camel Pose, to dive into that inner world. Kino will guide you through warm ups and then a series of backbends that will challenge you. The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

programme.title: Material relationships
programme.desc: Start your meditation practice with a few moments of mindful awareness built around the movement of the breath and the sensations of the body. Cultivate equanimity as you notice the rise and fall of physical and emotional feelings. Let Kino help you drop down beneath the frequency of thought, where you can get in touch with your innate wholeness. Work with understanding your natural completeness, as you explore concepts of attachment and aversion. Find yourself in alignment with faith, breaking the inertia of limiting beliefs and thoughts. Practice towards a state of non attachment, a fertile ground in which to plant the seeds of a happier, more peaceful life.

programme.title: Intro to Everyday Essentials
programme.desc: Sit down with Mark Robberds to discover what this Movement Essentials course is all about.

programme.title: Breathwork
programme.desc: Use this practice to work with improving your 3-dimensional breathing.

programme.title: Yoga and Indian Culture with Ajay Tokas
programme.desc: In this episode of seek up, Kino sits down to talk with level 2 authorized yoga teacher, Ajay Tokas.

programme.title: Standing Postures
programme.desc: Follow Mark as he walks your through techniques that will help you improve your function in standing poses.

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Yoga for Inflexible People - Light the Fire – Downward Dog
programme.desc: If you're feeling not so flexible, this course is where you should be! This class is focused on understanding shoulder mobility in the fundamental yoga asana called downdog,

programme.title: Yoga Is Happiness
programme.desc: You can be happy for no reason at all… Happiness can be our natural state. Start today with attention at the heart center and the recollection of an uplifting memory. Holding on to that feeling, move into practice with a warm up rooted in backbending and sun salutations. Next, follow Kino through through a hip opening sequence. As we approach today’s pinnacle pose, Baddha Konasana, remember that there is no need for the body to be in any particular place. Practice acceptance and happiness here and now.

programme.title: Crispy Orange Cauliﬂower “Chicken”
programme.desc: It’s a spin on Orange Chicken – learn how to make this delicious, crispy orange cauliflower with Alexa Soto.

programme.title: Apple Pie Pancakes
programme.desc: These Apple Pie Pancakes are gluten-free, vegan and very simple to make.

programme.title: Yoga Nidra for Healing
programme.desc: Join Irene for a Yoga Nidra practice is designed to promote healing in the body from the inside out.

programme.title: Yoga Is Prayer
programme.desc: Todays class offers an opportunity to understand practice as prayer. Join Kino as she uses Digasana, also known as Warrior 3, as an opportunity to feel the quiet turning inward of the mind. The Warrior postures help you connect to a sense of inner strength. Let Kino guide you through communion with self and you higher power as you flow through a challenging, prop supported balancing sequence.

programme.title: Handstands
programme.desc: Join Kino for 20 minutes of Handstand drills! Not recommended for beginners, this class does require a certain level of pre-established strength and flexibility. Work through these drills every week to take your handstand practice to the next level

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Ayurvedic Dessert
programme.desc: Sahara Rose is a big fan of dessert and in this episode she’s going to show you how to make a healthy Rice Pudding that will satisfy your sweet tooth and nourish your body at the same time. Less than 10 minutes.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: This practice takes you on a journey through the fundamentals of yoga and culminates in a gentle backbend, the bridge pose

programme.title: Yoga Is Equanimity
programme.desc: Lolasana is a challenging position that offers a unique opportunity to experience balance and equanimity in both the body and mind. Kino is here to help you find an experience of the equanimous mind, which is not moved by pleasure or pain. This class will guide you through a series of drills that might induce a state annoyance, so that you have an opportunity to practice returning to calm. Through this practice you will face your difficulties and make peace with being exactly where you are.

programme.title: Kino in Seattle
programme.desc: I don’t think we’re in Florida anymore! Follow along with Kino during her trip to Seattle, Washington as she adjusts to the colder weather, sets off in search of a hot cup of chai, tours historic areas like the Gas Works Park, supports local businesses, and shares the Ashtanga Yoga method with a group of excited yogis at the Yoga Lab Northwest.

programme.title: Yoga Is Patience
programme.desc: For many of us, patience does not come naturally. this class brings us an opportunity to understand patience through the twisting posture Marichasana C. Join Kino as she guides you into embodiment through breath awareness and gentle movement. Be patient and kind with your body as you move into the practice and a deeper twist through the spinal axis.

programme.title: Kino and Joseph Armstrong - A Story of Addiction
programme.desc: Get to know Joseph Armstrong, where he’s from and how he came to yoga.

programme.title: Yoga Is Breath
programme.desc: Tune into the truth of who you are underneath the thoughts, using the breath and practice as a means of transformation into true self. This class uses chair pose to explore both physical embodiment and to fuel our inner journey into yoga. Join us for a practice that will bring awareness into your hips and legs, using props to support the postures where needed. Let Kino guide you into a stronger awareness of Agni, the inner fire that burns through impurities and helps the mind see clearer.

programme.title: Tree Pose
programme.desc: A practice that builds up to tree pose. Get rooted into the fundamentals of yoga practice including breath and balance.

programme.title: Pigeon
programme.desc: Come explore supported hip opening with Kino. This class incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Pigeon Pose.

programme.title: Gratitude
programme.desc: This meditation for manifestation will bring gratitude into your life. Settle the attention on the breath as you drop below the frequency of thought and into a more receptive state. Open up to the field of arising sensation and connect a sense of gratitude for the body as a tool in your mindfulness practice. Cultivate awareness of your inner experience, moving away from loops of thoughts and into a state of equanimity, alignment, deep peace and gratitude.

programme.title: Twist - The Heart - Feel
programme.desc: The final class in this series is all about feeling into and entering the heart space through the vehicle of twists. The unfelt body is a reservoir of the unlived life. Unlock your potential for healing by connecting with these deep inner spaces of the body and just feeling.

programme.title: Kino and Yuko Talk about the Vegan Diet, Yoga and Japanese Food
programme.desc: Learn know more about Yuko, including when and how she got into yoga after sustaining a major back injury.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Kapha
programme.desc: As you’ve learned, Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for each of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will guide you through a meditation that’s designed specifically for Kapha type people.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Course Intro
programme.desc: This course is focused on merging Ayurveda with modern nutritional science and a dedicated yoga practice so that you can work toward becoming your highest self. But what exactly is Ayurveda? Tune in to find out and discover what this course is all about.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Ayurvedic Dessert
programme.desc: Sahara Rose is a big fan of dessert and in this episode she’s going to show you how to make a healthy Rice Pudding that will satisfy your sweet tooth and nourish your body at the same time. Less than 10 minutes.

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Discover Your Dosha
programme.desc: Why does Ayurveda matter and how can it help you understand yourself and the world around you? In this episode, Sahara will briefly discuss each of the three doshas and what they have to do with you and the foods you eat? Learn about how your digestion can be affected by the doshas, and how the doshas might be affecting you through this brief intro to Ayurveda with Sahara Rose. Less that 20 minutes.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Pitta
programme.desc: Since Ayurveda recommends different yoga and meditation practices for the each of the different Doshas, in today’s episode, Sahara Rose is offering a specific meditation practice that’s designed for Pitta type people. About 10 minutes.

programme.title: Pigeon
programme.desc: Come explore supported hip opening with Kino. This class incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Pigeon Pose.

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for one of her favorite daily yoga drills, plank! Kino takes you through a quick warm up before diving into the challenging world of plank pose. Get ready to tone your core and strengthen your shoulders!

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Everyday Drill
programme.desc: When it comes to building strength and flexibility for a more well-rounded yoga practice, yoga drills can help you expedite the process! Join Kino for a set of yoga drills that offer a little mix of everything. Stretch out and strengthen the core, legs, arms, shoulders, and everything in between. Just over 20 minutes.

programme.title: Kino in Budapest
programme.desc: One of Kino’s favorite hobbies is learning how to say ‘Thank You’ in different languages. In this episode of Global Yoga, she's learning that special phrase in Hungarian, as she travels to Budapest. Travel to St Stephen's cathedral, one of the biggest structures in the country, stroll the Danube River and visit Heroes Square, a World Heritage Site. Join Kino as she explores the rich history of this ancient country while on her journey of sharing yoga with the world.

programme.title: Super Bowl
programme.desc: Original 1988 Super Bowl of Drag Racing. The video that changed the look of Drag TV with quirky innovations both invasive, explosive and thrilling. Stars NHRA Top Fuel Heroes Shirley, Ormsby, LaHaie, Snow, Amato, Tripp Shumake, Kenny Bernstein, Snake, John Force.

programme.title: Big Daddy Returns
programme.desc: In pursuit of 300 mph by "Big Daddy" Don Garlits at the 2002 US Nationals. A private portrayal of the human side of John Force in his RV. Darrell Gwynn electric dragster. Shirley vs Big Daddy in their last ever dramatic match up.

programme.title: Nasty Doorslammers
programme.desc: 1990 Fabulous East Coast Doorslammers tear up E-town. Atco Raceway night racing; Blown vs Nitrous. Boss Sauce rollover 13 times; Killer Brooks, Carolyn Melendy, Animal Jim, Wally Bell, Wayne Torkelson, Jim Oddy Animal Jim Fuelher, Carl Moyer

programme.title: Funny Car Experience
programme.desc: The Original, First ever Drag Racing Video, 1986. NHRA Funny Cars: Al Segrini, Frank Hawley, Al Hofmann, Dale Pulde, Chuck Etchells, Nick Boninfante, John Force, Bobby Lagana, Frank Kramberger, Jerry Caminito, and Kenny Berstein.

programme.title: Documentary - Abandoned Dreams
programme.desc: The abandoned boat dilemma is one of the most frustrating and alarming issues facing British Columbia's coastal communities. Reaching the end of their life cycle, with limited disposal options and almost no way to track ownership, hundreds of old boats are being left to rot, and sink or drift onto beaches and shorelines around our province. The result is a province-wide problem that affects coastal navigation, tourism and the environment. Abandoned Dreams looks into the root causes of this derelict boat epidemic and the future plans for safe boat disposal and recycling in BC.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Episode 6 - GP Suzuki
programme.desc: Dehesa Montenmedio farewells this October Tour with the Grand Prix Suzuki. The 1.55m circuit designed by Javier Trenor has seen 6 pairs of riders and horses achieve the jump-off, but the challenge is just starting. Riders rush through the CSIO3* course, and results are unpredictable. Watch the best moments of the GP Suzuki celebrated in Spain 2021.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Sopot
FEI Icons - Episode 5 - Boyd Exell
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic name in the sport of carriage driving, the Australian Boyd Exell. Fascinated by horses from a very young age, he moved to the United Kingdom to develop this early talent, and soon he became the first Athlete in history of the sport to compete in three different World Championships: horse singles, horse pairs and four in hand.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 6 - Martin Fuchs
programme.desc: FEI Icons is a series looking back at the careers of some of the most successful and influential equestrian athletes of the 21st century. In this episode, we are focussing on the Swiss sensation, Martin Fuchs, who at only 27 years old had already propelled himself to the top of the Show jumping world. Discover his story.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
Polo Rider Cup Competition - Dos Lunas Polo Club vs Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz
programme.desc: Dos Lunas Polo Club is facing Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz in this heated game at the Polo Rider Cup 2021. Playing with a 10/12 goals handicap and 5 chukkers, both teams will try their best to keep advancing in the tournament, but it will not be an easy feat. Watch the best moments of the competition.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Polo Club de Chantilly vs Polo Park Zürich
programme.desc: The hosting team, Polo Club de Chantilly, is ready to take Polo Park Zürich in this game for the Polo Rider Cup. Find out on the Polo Rider Cup 2021 Competition.

programme.desc: Bruno Chimirri lectures the students on what is needed to become an equestrian pro. Then, the students get on the reins to practice jumps.

Sunshine Tour - GP Equine America
programme.desc: The Equine America Grand Prix is one of the most demanding courses in the Andalucía Sunshine Tour. This year, from an initial field of 48, just five riders have managed to get through to the jump off with clear rounds, while the next five places were taken by riders who finished with time penalties. Designed by Grégory Bodo and Alain Lhopital, this 1.55m show jumping course has the crowd go crazy in their seats. Are you going to miss out?

programme.title: FEI Ride Originals - Episode 6 - Hardy Haflingers, Swiss Stars & Pint-sized Ponies
programme.desc: This month on Ride from FEI Originals presented by Longines we visit Moscarr Farm in the East Midlands, home to a hardy herd of Haflingers and the oldest UK stud of its kind. We spend time with Swiss Jumping sensation and Longines’ Ambassador Edouard Schmitz and big-up the pint-sized Shetland pony stealing people’s hearts in Germany.

programme.title: FEI Awards 2021
programme.desc: More than 300 guests including equestrian legends, National Federations, FEI partners and stakeholders have attended the 13th FEI Awards. Equestrian commentator Steven Wilde has acted as the Master of Ceremonies of this international congregation of the equestrian community. The 2020 Award winners have also been present this year in Antwerp - Ingrid Klimke, Semmieke Rothenberger, Carmen Thiemman, Angelika Trabert, the Ebony Horse Club and more. However, in comparison with last year, this time stars of equestrian sports have been able to celebrate in person, bringing together the equine world to celebrate these achievements. This edition of the FEI Awards is more special as it is the FEI's centennial year and the nominees are of the greatest calibre. Find out how the FEI Awards 2021 went on HorseTV.

This area is unique for its romantic cities and villages surrounded by abundant countryside, hills and woodlands. Relive the most exciting moments of the 2019 finale at Lignieres.

programme.title: FEI Dressage World Cup - Episode 1 - Salzburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Salzburg for the second leg of the FEI Dressage World Cup. We are in Austria to see some of the very best horse and rider combinations in the sport. Celebrating its 35th year, the FEI Dressage World Cup is the most distinguished individual competition in the international dressage calendar. Despite these challenging times and many events getting cancelled, Salzburg has proved herself a safe host to bring back the sport. Relive the highlights of the competition in Salzburg in the FEI Dressage World Cup of 2021.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep4 - Madrid
FEI Awards 2021
programme.desc: More than 300 guests including equestrian legends, National Federations, FEI partners and stakeholders have attended the 13th FEI Awards. Equestrian commentator Steven Wilde has acted as the Master of Ceremonies of this international congregation of the equestrian community. The 2020 Award winners have also been present this year in Antwerp - Ingrid Klimke, Semmieke Rothenberger, Carmen Thiemman, Angelika Trabert, the Ebony Horse Club and more. However, in comparison with last year, this time stars of equestrian sports have been able to celebrate in person, bringing together the equine world to celebrate these achievements. This edition of the FEI Awards is more special as it is the FEI's centennial year and the nominees are of the greatest calibre. Find out how the FEI Awards 2021 went on HorseTV.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup (Full Competition) - Ep6 - Rotterdam
Dressage Season Review - Episode 1
programme.desc: The best action in the dressage world is ready for the 2016/2017 edition. programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 3 - Teams on Top
programme.desc: Team jumping competitions started in 1909, and in 1929 FEI created the Nations Cup. Since, the sport has evolved to become a dynamic competition. In this episode, we will look back at some of most iconic wins in the FEI Jumping Nations Cup. Watch how it has evolved from its military background to the electrifying sport we watch today.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this month's show, we look back on Boyd Exell's memorable 2018 driving season and travel to Reykjavik to learn more about the Icelandic Horse breed. Also, we will be visiting Gina Schumacher in Geneva to catch up on the action from the Longines FEI World Cup Jumping series. Welcome to FEI Equestrian World.

programme.title: Longines Masters of New York
programme.desc: The Longines Masters of New York proudly offer unparalleled first-class sport attracting the world's top-ranked equestrian athletes to the Big Apple. This heart-pounding equestrian sport is a one in a lifetime experience for riders and spectators likewise. It divides in classes such as the unique Longines Speed Challenge, dubbed the fastest class in the world, and the Longines Grand Prix. If this was not enough it is accompanied by live performances, luxury shopping in the Prestige Village, delicious cuisine and more surprises we don’t want to miss out. Taking up the spotlight, the Riders Masters Cup showcases two rounds of one-on-one speed duels to decide the winning team in a transatlantic battle of Riders USA vs. Riders Europe. A real match between the world's two major equestrian powers, the USA and Europe. Which continent will defeat the other? Find it out on HorseTV.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Andalucía - March
programme.desc: The CSI4* Andalucía GP takes place in the main arena of the Sunshine Tour, and it is the 3rd qualifier for the Invitational GP. The 1.55m course counts for the Longines ranking, so all riders are ready to give it their all to improve their international rankings. Watch the best moments of the Andalucía GP 2022 edition.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Vancouver
Black Bears Women´s Tournament - Final
programme.desc: Park Place and Tarantula will fight in the final of the awaited Black Bears Women's Tournament. Eight women's teams up to 18-goals have fought for the title, however, after several days of competition, only two remain in one of the most exciting finals in this tournament.Don't miss out on the 2020 final of the Black Bears Women's Tournament!
